stem: The masses, in grams, of large boxes of chocolates and small boxes of chocolates have the distributions $\text{N}(325, 6.1)$ and $\text{N}(167, 5.6)$ respectively.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total mass of 10 randomly chosen large boxes of chocolates is less than 3240 g.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that the mass of a randomly chosen large box of chocolates is more than twice the mass of a randomly chosen small box of chocolates.
